heating_cooling: Cold winters are the main threat. Plan to heat one small room; insulate windows; layer wool or synthetics; never use grills, ovens or generators indoors.

risks: Farm runoff can raise nitrates in wells. Boiling does NOT remove nitrate and can concentrate it; dangerous for infants under 6 months (CDC, EPA).
Arsenic: USGS estimates roughly 151,000 people here use private wells likely above EPA's arsenic limit (2017 model estimate). Boiling does NOT remove arsenic; test private wells.
water.drinking_water_program: Search 'Indiana drinking water program' or ask your water utility; private well guidance: https://www.epa.gov/privatewells
